title: Impact of Rising Interest Rates on HDB Flat Owners on Private Bank Home Loans
what_it_is: Impact of Rising Interest Rates on HDB Flat Owners on Private Bank Home Loans

sections.label: FI housing loan rates
sections.summary: About 80% of those with housing loans from financial institutions are on mortgage packages tracking market interest rates, with some lag.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For those with housing loans from financial institutions (FIs), about 80% are on mortgage packages that track market interest rates, but with some lag.

sections.label: HDB loan rate unchanged
sections.summary: HDB borrowers' repayments are unaffected by rising interest rates as the HDB concessionary loan rate remains unchanged at 2.6% per annum, reviewed quarterly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For borrowers who have taken housing loans from HDB, their mortgage repayments would not have been affected by rising interest rates, as the HDB concessionary loan rate, which is reviewed quarterly, remains unchanged at 2.6% per annum.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The proportion of non-performing mortgages among HDB flat owners has remained low and stable for housing loans extended by both HDB and FIs.

sections.label: Interest rate floors introduced
sections.summary: MAS increased the medium-term interest rate floor for TDSR and MSR on FI property loans, and HDB introduced an interest rate floor for HDB housing loans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: MAS increased the medium-term interest rate floor used to compute the Total Debt Servicing Ratio (TDSR) and the MSR for property loans by FIs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB introduced an interest rate floor to compute eligible loans for housing loans granted by HDB.

sections.label: Assistance for HDB borrowers
sections.summary: HDB offers financial assistance measures to HDB loan borrowers, and MND, HDB, MOM and MAS worked with FIs on a standardised workflow to assist flat owners in distress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For HDB home owners with housing loans granted by HDB, HDB has various financial assistance measures in place to help them, which include allowing them to reduce or defer their loan instalments for six months; pay their arrears by instalments within a reasonable period; and/or extend their loan tenure to help reduce their monthly instalments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: MND, HDB, MOM and MAS have worked with FIs to establish a standardised workflow to assist HDB flat owners in distress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This includes working with flat owners on potential loan restructuring solutions, referring them to HDB and social service agencies for assistance and, where foreclosures by banks or FIs are unavoidable, work with flat owners to source for their next accommodation.
